notes.title: Update Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Friendly and Enemy NPCs[/h2]
[list]
[*]New NPCs now roam the [b]wasteland[/b] — both friendly and hostile
[*]Over [b]40 unique interactions[/b] added
[*]Encounters can now lead to:
[list]
[*]Zombie hordes
[*]Epic gunfights
[*]Bonus loot drops
[*]Dialogue and new characters
[/list]
[/list]
[h2]New Massive Locations[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added a [b]Strip Mall[/b] in the [b]Northwest corner[/b] of the map
[*]Added a [b]Country Club[/b] in the [b]Northeast corner[/b] of the map
[/list]
[h2]New Map Item[/h2]
[list]
[*]A new collectible map item can now be found in the [b]wasteland[/b]
[/list]
[h2]Updated Intro Animation[/h2]
[list]
[*]Refreshed the intro sequence with improved visuals and timing
[/list]

notes.title: Upcoming Features for Dead Unending 2.0
notes.content:
[h1]Major Update for Dead Unending Coming May 2025![/h1]

I'm excited to announce a [b]major update[/b] for [i]Dead Unending[/i] arriving in [b]May 2025[/b]! 

I’ll be posting updates throughout the development process as more content is added, and I’ll continue fixing bugs found during [u][url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeQ0i02rgb2MqUqD_CYVm7IaElItdZApsjdBnsOOjZUKduNyg/viewform?usp=sf_link]continuous playtesting[/url][u]

Stay tuned for more details, and thank you for your support!
